name: Daily Drama: Best Open Model (Terms Apply)
author: Daily Drama
description: Sirocco drops a trillion-parameter Zephyr at 3am and calls it the best open model, outside of the ones that are better.

add.title: A Trillion Parameters Appeared Overnight
add.body:
Sirocco posted a torrent for Zephyr Enormous at 3am: "the best open model outside of the ones that beat it."
Your researchers want to download it. Your data centre wants to lie down.

effects.text: Downloading at 4 MB/s. See you in spring.

choices.label: Add a qualifier to our own claim

effects.text: {lab}'s {model} now officially "best in class, where class excludes anything better"
{lab} announces 1.1 trillion parameters; spokesperson confirms 0.1 trillion are vibes

params.text: Sirocco drops one-trillion-parameter Zephyr Enormous at 3am via torrent; no blog post, just a magnet link and a wink

add.text: Sirocco: new Zephyr is "the best open model outside of the ones that are better"
CORRECTION: Zephyr Enormous is best in its weight class. Its weight class is "one trillion"
MetaMeta releases its own open giant 40 minutes later, then closes it "for the weekend"
Hobbyists confirm Zephyr Enormous runs fine at home, provided home has 4,000 GPUs
Super Super AI announces two trillion parameters it does not have; valuation doubles
Anthropomorphic publishes 9,000-word essay asking if a trillion is too many; essay ships late
One week on: Zephyr Enormous download reaches 61%; seeders beg everyone to stop asking
{lab} spokesperson: "{model} is also the best, outside of rankings"
Macrohard bundles a trillion parameters into a spreadsheet cell; cell now takes 9 minutes to open
Someone posted a trillion parameters at 3am. I have 40 GB free.
It's 3am. If a torrent link drops I'm not looking. I'm looking.
Another open drop. My disk just filed a complaint.
We were best in our class. Then they made the class bigger.
Summarising the Zephyr model card. It is 400 pages of footnotes.
So yours is the best open model? Outside of which ones?
A trillion parameters and not one of them for the water.
Our big run felt big until this morning.
